copy.title: one rung up
welcome: thank you for coming here when it's heavy. that's a kind thing to do.
we'll go one small step at a time. no big leaps, and stopping any time is fine.
copy.helpNote: if it ever feels like more than this can hold, real help is in
copy.sentencePlaceholder: type it, or tap one below
copy.sentenceNote: it stays on this screen. it's only saved if you choose to keep it.
copy.nearSol: thanks for putting it into words. naming it already helps a little.
copy.whyTitle: why one rung at a time
why: a big, bright sentence can land badly when it's far from what feels true. in some studies, it left people feeling worse.
so each rung here is a thought just a little lighter than the last, close enough to believe.
looking at the same moment from a slightly different angle is called reappraisal. it's well studied, and many people find it helps.
copy.rungAsk: which thought is a little lighter, and still believable?
copy.smallerSol: that's honest, and it helps to know. let's find a smaller step.
copy.smallerAsk: a smaller step, closer to where things are
copy.ownPlaceholder: write it your way, or tap an idea
copy.trueNote: an honest number is the useful one. there's no right answer.
heldSol: that one holds. thank you for being honest about it.
copy.heldTop: five rungs. that's a good place to look back from.
shortSol: thanks for saying so honestly. that tells us how big a step fits today.
a rung that doesn't hold yet isn't a problem. it's information.
copy.shortAgain: no pressure. a rung can wait, and so can the rest.
copy.afterSol: thank you for staying with it.
copy.climbNote: bottom to top, in the words that were true enough to stand on.
copy.ladderLabel: the climb, from the bottom up
copy.keepSentenceNote: the sentence is only saved if this is ticked.
copy.kept: kept in the book. thank you for taking this time.
copy.carry: take the top rung into today
copy.carried: the top rung is set aside for today.
copy.bookNote: each climb, in the words that were true enough to stand on.
